clips.caption:
You asked for Susie. You got told no.

That's not punishment, it's protection. The moment you put a deadline on your prayer, you cut yourself off from the part you can't see coming yet. Susie wasn't the plan. Mary was, and she's two months away, already better.

Same with the loan you prayed for and didn't get. Maybe the market was about to crash, and losing that house was the blessing, not the loss.

You don't know what's off your radar screen. Stop timing the universe.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of the teaching.
